name: Ghosts. The Nature of Fear
overview: Every day of the cemetery's caretaker is scheduled by the hour: to repair a sagging fence, clean up old graves, and drive informal teenagers from the cemetery. He lost his beloved wife and daughter in a plane crash and spent his whole life trying in vain to find any way to contact them in the afterlife. Eventually, he realized that the only ghost stuck between the world of the living and the world of the dead was himself. One day, however, he discovers that the afterlife exists. But you can only meet him at death's door.
